needs.reason: junit-jupiter and junit-platform-launcher carry no version: junit-bom 5.11.3, imported with platform(), fixes them to 5.11.3 and 1.11.3 (checked on Maven Central). Only a Gradle resolution, or a reader that fetches the BOM, knows them.

traps: The wrapper declares Gradle 8.11.1 but gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar is not in the fixture: ./gradlew cannot start until someone runs gradle wrapper or supplies the jar.
gradlew, gradlew.bat and gradle/wrapper/ are vendored for Linguist: they are not project Shell or Batchfile code.
Java 17 is sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility, not a toolchain: Gradle compiles with whatever JDK runs it, with -source 17 -target 17 (no --release).
platform('org.junit:junit-bom:5.11.3') is a version source, not a dependency of the project; it is not listed.
The launcher's version 1.11.3 is not 5.11.3: the JUnit Platform has its own numbering inside the same BOM.
The unit name is the Gradle path ':'; rootProject.name 'hello-groovy' is the project's display name and artifact base name.
The application plugin's mainClass makes App.java the entry file.
resolved for junit-jupiter (5.11.3) and junit-platform-launcher (1.11.3) is read from junit-bom 5.11.3 as published on Maven Central.
